claims.text: For the 10 classes 1-shot multi-class classification problem, VAGER+Voting achieves the highest accuracy across the evaluated groups (67.59% for 10 cls/G1, 63.96% for 10 cls/G2, 58.02% for 10 cls/G3, 51.27% for 10 cls/G4, and 56.24% for 10 cls/G5), performing best among the compared methods.
